name: std/atomic
description: Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
readme: Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
Import this module with use atomic.

files.content:
-- Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
public define Atom as opaque.
public use "atomic" function create(value of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to Atom.
public use "atomic" function release(value of type pointer to Atom) of type nothing.
public use "atomic" function load(value of type pointer to Atom, order of type text) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "atomic" function store(value of type pointer to Atom, number of type unsigned 64, order of type text) of type fallible nothing.
public use "atomic" function add(value of type pointer to Atom, number of type unsigned 64, order of type text) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "atomic" function swap(value of type pointer to Atom, number of type unsigned 64, order of type text) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "atomic" function replace(value of type pointer to Atom, expected of type unsigned 64, number of type unsigned 64, order of type text) of type fallible boolean.
